title: Plan review layout sample
summary: A sample for inspecting native plan layout, wrapping, decision controls and the review footer. Approving this sample requests only a reply confirming sample approval; it requests no code work.

options.label: Keep a deliberately long option title visible beside its selection control as the available reading width becomes smaller
options.description: This description adds enough context to wrap at narrow widths. Inspect whether the selection control stays aligned with the first title line and whether the description follows the same text column.

options.label: Use a shorter title with a longer explanation
options.description: Imagine a reader comparing several reasonable choices before responding. The explanation should remain readable, preserve its spacing, and avoid pushing content beneath the fixed plan header or footer as the decision is selected.

claims.detail: Review response lets you inspect feedback before sending. If you approve this sample, reply only with confirmation that the sample was approved. Do not implement or change product code.
